items.purpose: Cover background (Slide 01) — Hello World programming concept
items.prompt: Clean flat vector illustration backdrop with bold geometric shapes and confident solid fills. Crisp outlines (1.5-2px equivalent stroke weight, consistent across all elements) define every form. No gradients within shapes — color is applied as flat blocks. Subtle shadow only where it adds depth (soft 8% opacity drop, no harsh edges). Composition is grid-aware and balanced, with deliberate negative space carrying as much weight as filled areas. Iconography is simplified to essential geometry — recognizable at small sizes. Overall feel is modern, professional, and confidently restrained. Color behavior is restrained-corporate: white #FFFFFF carries 60% of the canvas as calm breathing space across the center and upper region; primary blue #2563EB forms confident geometric blocks — a stylized terminal window shape in the lower-left and abstract code brackets radiating from it (about 30% area); accent green #10B981 appears only as two small geometric dots suggesting cursor blinks, together under 5% of the area. No additional colors. The scene suggests the moment of a first program running — a friendly terminal floating in clean space with angle-bracket symbols and curly braces radiating outward as abstract geometric shapes. Small geometric circles and lines suggest digital connection and discovery. The central 60% of the canvas is deliberately calm and unbusy, ready to receive a slide title overlaid in SVG. Composed as a 1280x720 full-bleed PPT background. NO text of any kind anywhere in the image — no letters, numbers, signs, watermarks, labels, or written symbols. Color values (HEX codes like #2563EB) and color names are rendering guidance only — do NOT display HEX codes, color names, or palette labels as visible text anywhere in the image.
items.alt_text: Abstract vector illustration of a friendly terminal with code symbols radiating outward, representing Hello World
